entities.summary: Diana Santos Fleischman is an evolutionary psychologist and podcaster. Her field of research includes the study of disgust, human sexuality, eugenics, and hormones and behaviour. She also has interests in natalism, effective altruism, animal welfare, and feminism. She is one of the hosts of the Aporia podcast.
